title: 第15章 对练和包子
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
周日早上八点，青岚武道高中的练功房。

    练功房在演武场东侧的独立建筑里，周末对排名前二十的学生开放，安槐和苏念念的排名都在范围内，刷了学生卡就进去了。

    练功房里空间很大，地面铺着厚实的减震垫，墙壁挂着各种训练器具，周末人少，只有零星几个高年级的学生在角落里练功。

    苏念念甩了甩手臂，站到了空地中央。

    “来，跟我练。”

    安槐把外套脱了搁在旁边，走到她对面。

    “规则？”

    “自由对练，点到为止。”苏念念活动了一下脖子，“你别放水。”

    “好。”

    苏念念率先动了。

    她的起手速度极快，半步切入近身距离，右拳带着断岳拳特有的短促劲力直奔安槐的肩膀。

    安槐侧身避开，没有反击，而是后退半步拉开距离。

    苏念念皱眉。

    “你在干什么？打回来啊。”

    “先看看老大的节奏。”

    苏念念哼了一声，再次欺身上前，这次出拳更快，左右交替，拳风呼啸，安槐在她的攻击范围里灵活闪避，像一条游鱼在拳影间穿梭，始终不出手。

    苏念念的攻击从第一式打到第三式，连贯流畅，到了第三式和第四式衔接的位置，安槐精准地捕捉到了那个零点三秒的停顿。

    就是现在。

    安槐的右手从身侧划出一个弧线，指尖轻轻点在苏念念的左肩上。

    苏念念身体一僵。

    她的第四式被打断了，安槐的手指停在她肩膀上，力道轻得像落了一片树叶。

    “一比零。”安槐说。

    苏念念退后两步，表情从震惊变成了思考。

    她没有问安槐是怎么做到的，而是闭上眼回想刚才的出拳过程。

    三秒后，她睁开眼。

    “三式和四式中间，我停了一下。”

    安槐微微点头。

    苏念念的眉头拧了起来。

    “以前练的时候没觉得有问题啊。”

    “单独打靶看不出来，对练就明显了。”安槐退了一步，重新摆好姿势，“再来？”

    苏念念深吸一口气，重新冲了上来。

    这一次，她刻意注意了衔接的问题，第三式收拳的时候多带了半分力，试图用惯性来弥补停顿。

    比刚才好了一些，但还是慢了零点一秒。

    安槐再次在空档的瞬间出手，指尖点上她的右肘。

    “二比零。”

    苏念念咬了咬牙。

    第三次。

    第四次。
content_en:
It’s eight o’clock in the morning on Sunday, in the practice room of Qinglan Martial Arts High School.

The practice room is in an independent building on the east side of the martial arts field. It is open to the top twenty students on weekends. An Huai and Su Niannian's rankings are both within the range. They swiped their student cards and entered.

The practice room is very spacious, with thick shock-absorbing mats on the floor and various training equipment hung on the walls. There are few people on weekends, with only a few senior students practicing in the corner.

Su Niannian shook her arms and stood in the middle of the open space.

"Come, practice with me."

An Huai took off his coat and put it aside, then walked across from her.

"Rules?"

"Free sparring, until the point is reached." Su Niannian moved her neck, "Don't let it go."

"Okay."

Su Niannian took the lead.

She started very quickly, cutting into close range with half a step, and her right fist went straight to An Huai's shoulder with the short force unique to the Duan Yue Quan.

An Huai sidestepped and did not fight back. Instead, he took half a step back to distance himself.

Su Niannian frowned.

"What are you doing? Call me back."

"Let's see the boss's rhythm first."

Su Niannian snorted and stepped forward again. This time the punches were faster, alternating left and right, and the wind of the fists roared. An Huai nimbly dodged within the range of her attack, like a fish swimming between the shadows of the fists, never taking a shot.

Su Niannian's attack was consistent and smooth from the first to the third move. When the third move and the fourth move were connected, An Huai accurately captured the pause of 0.3 seconds.

That's it now.

An Huai's right hand drew an arc from his side, and his fingertips gently touched Su Niannian's left shoulder.

Su Niannian's body stiffened.

Her fourth posture was interrupted, and An Huai's fingers stopped on her shoulders, as light as a fallen leaf.

"One to zero." An Huai said.

Su Niannian took two steps back, her expression changing from shock to thinking.

She didn't ask An Huai how he did it, but closed her eyes and thought about the punching process just now.

Three seconds later, she opened her eyes.

"Between the third and fourth poses, I paused."

An Huai nodded slightly.

Su Niannian's brows wrinkled.

"I didn't think there was any problem when I practiced before."

"It's not obvious when you're shooting alone, but it's obvious when you practice sparring." An Huai took a step back and repositioned himself, "Again?"

Su Niannian took a deep breath and rushed forward again.

This time, she deliberately paid attention to the problem of connection. When closing the fist in the third position, she used half more force, trying to use inertia to make up for the pause.

It's better than before, but still a tenth of a second slower.

An Huai struck again at the moment of opportunity, his fingertips touching her right elbow.

"Two to zero."

Su Niannian gritted her teeth.

The third time.

The fourth time.
